claim_types.use: Fact supported by source material; cite when answering.
AIWF-specific operating preference or repo convention; do not present as universal fact.
Recommended practice based on sources/project experience; state as recommendation.
Unproven product/research direction; mark as tentative.
User-supplied research note; preserve but verify for high-stakes/current claims.
Old project version or provenance trail; do not treat as current.

answer_guidance: When claims of different types conflict, prefer sourced_fact for external facts, project_policy for AIWF repo behavior, and operational_recommendation for implementation choices. Surface the distinction.
